scope: Locally implemented geometry routes and native solver interfaces; this is a capability contract, not a claim of clinical validation.

minimum_case_inputs: simulation_config.json schema v4 with geometry and mesh blocks
one geometry.file in the same case directory

accepted_geometry.contract: Exactly seven columns: id type x y z radius parent_id; one root, connected acyclic tree, finite coordinates, positive radius.
Radius-annotated line OBJ containing only v and l records; each vertex is x y z radius auxiliary0 auxiliary1; no faces.

routes.source_units: Coordinates and radii are multiplied by geometry.length_scale_to_m; mesh.centerline.target_spacing remains in source-coordinate units.
routes.labels: Generated control-mesh point label 0 is wall, positive terminal labels start at 1, and -1 is interior. Boundary physics is still declared explicitly in simulation_config.json.
limitations: The 3D control-mesh route accepts rooted trees with at most two children per node.
It is not a general surface-to-volume mesher.
Template assets are installed program resources, not user case inputs.

minimum_case_inputs: an explicit positive length scale to metres when source coordinates are not metres

accepted_geometry.contract: Bounded uncompressed XML PolyData subset with one piece, triangular Polys, and one nonnegative integer boundary_id (or explicitly named boundary array) per triangle; ASCII, inline base64, and appended base64 arrays are accepted.
ASCII or binary STL; because STL has no labels, every triangle receives the explicitly configured default boundary ID.

routes.source_units: Coordinates are multiplied by --length-scale-to-m and thereafter stored in metres.
routes.labels: Every source boundary ID becomes Gmsh physical surface boundary_label_<integer>; the only supported volume physical name is fluid. Wall/inlet/outlet meaning is assigned by solver case configuration, never by numeric order.
meshers: Gmsh reference adapter with exact input-facet preservation
separately installed fTetWild adapter with envelope-constrained remeshing and source-label projection
generated_runtime_inputs: ASCII Gmsh 4.1 .msh containing first-order type-2 boundary triangles and type-4 tetrahedra
limitations: One fluid region only; no internal material interface.
No implicit capping, repair, smoothing, or unit inference.
OFF, OBJ, and PLY are not accepted by the shared project surface preflight even though the external fTetWild executable supports them.

minimum_case_inputs: one closed triangular VTP reference surface named by immersed_geometry.json.surface
matching graph port metadata when open ports are used

accepted_geometry.contract: Same bounded VTP subset and per-cell nonnegative integer boundary array as SurfaceReaders; production ImmersedFlowCase always uses the VTP reader.

routes.source_units: Production immersed surfaces and grid bounds are already in metres; there is no runtime scale or unit inference. Prescribed material frames also require metre coordinates and prohibit welding.
routes.labels: wall_labels and positive graph/runtime port boundary labels must be unique, disjoint, and exactly partition all VTP boundary IDs; port IDs and control modes must agree between graph metadata and immersed_geometry.json.
optional_inputs: prescribed_motion frames, each a topology-compatible material VTP with time_s
limitations: STL is supported by the reusable surface reader but not by the production ImmersedFlowCase entry point.
Paths must remain inside the case directory.
Topology-changing prescribed motion is not accepted.

minimum_case_inputs: simulation_config.json schema v3 with dimension 1d, geometry, fields, time, equation_systems, and boundaries
one geometry.file in the same case directory
every temporal table or replay asset referenced by the active configuration

accepted_geometry.contract: The strict seven-column rooted SWC contract.
The strict radius-annotated line OBJ contract; root_node_id may select the root.

routes.source_units: Coordinates and radius are multiplied by geometry.length_scale_to_m; all solver-facing flow quantities use the global SI units.
routes.labels: Boundaries use explicit roles inlet, outlet, or wall plus optional geometry node_ids; they do not use 3D mesh-face labels. Omitted outlet node_ids means all leaf nodes.
limitations: Cyclic OBJ graphs are restricted to the documented implicit flow-only subset.
Species concentration units are user-selected and must be internally consistent.

minimum_inputs: a complete labelled triangular exterior boundary
runtime_interfaces.format: Gmsh 4.1 ASCII, 8-byte real declaration; type-2 triangles and type-4 tetrahedra are consumed.
runtime_interfaces.labels: Surface physical names are boundary_label_<integer>; the volume physical name is exactly fluid. Every exterior tetrahedron face must occur exactly once in the labelled triangle set.
runtime_interfaces.discretization: Repository-owned Taylor-Hood P2 velocity/P1 pressure; PETSc supplies distributed algebra and nonlinear/linear solver services only.

minimum_inputs: every actively referenced profile or temporal asset
runtime_interfaces.format: Versioned repository .ntiga binary interface produced by iga_pack; legacy text extraction files are preprocessing fallback inputs, not solver runtime replacements.
runtime_interfaces.labels: controlmesh.vtk point labels and packed boundary-face labels must agree with explicit simulation_config.json boundary rules.

explicit_rejections: Unknown file extensions or schema keys.
Missing VTP triangle labels unless an explicit default is part of the selected reader path.
Compressed or multi-piece VTP, non-triangular polygons, nonfinite coordinates, open/nonmanifold/self-intersecting surfaces, and ambiguous fTetWild label projection.
Boundary semantics inferred from organ name, label order, file order, partition owner, or geometric direction.
Binary or higher-order Gmsh input to the native tetrahedral reader.
